headline: Djokovic beats top seed Zverev 4-6, 6-4, 6-4 in Beijing
whyCareReason: The China Open quarterfinal is final. Alcaraz is through in Tokyo. Monday's semifinals are not in the book.
teaser: ATP: Djokovic [6] d Zverev [1] 4-6, 6-4, 6-4. Semifinals are next.
story: ATP published the China Open quarterfinal: Novak Djokovic, seeded 6, beat Alexander Zverev, the top seed, 4-6, 6-4, 6-4. The same day in Tokyo, Carlos Alcaraz beat Denis Shapovalov 7-6 (3), 2-1 retired. Monday's semifinals were not played when this desk closed. Sinner remains out of Shanghai. No Shanghai result is printed.
stakes: A Beijing semifinal. The next match is not a result.
rivalryAngle: Sixth seed over the top seed. The China Open record cited by ATP for Djokovic is 32-0.
